server/utils/telegram.js (Bot API sends, audio upload) and server/utils/pendingCall.js (VA-calling claim-then-call primitives and the DB-backed outbound spend cap), created 2026-07-01, matched no glob and stayed invisible to review-scaling until 2026-07-22.

The third-revision marketing spec demoted the approved design to a 'Design source:' citation, no plan lane owned visual fidelity, the DesignSync pull-back never ran and every gate validated only its immediate upstream, so an off-design UI passed every review.
Subagents refuse to mint dev tokens, so they cannot sign in to the dev client for browser checks.

Subagent dispatches repeatedly came back dead on arrival (zero tool calls or echoed prompt fragments, once instruction-shaped), about 17 review-fleet times across crossnav, cc-import pushes, the 7/01 lanes, the comms send-modal push and the 7/13 batch plus both implementer dispatches for Money Board lane d, each needing a re-dispatch or an inline build.

Repo-worthy docs (an audit batch plan, the cc-importer v1 spec and plan stranded in the cc-import worktree, and others) sat untracked until an 8-agent sweep rescued them to main.
A private key copied between Windows machines kept too-open ACLs and Windows OpenSSH silently skipped it (dev-box infra).
On Windows, lane node_modules junctions broke after npm install in a worktree (reference_worktree_npm_install_junction).
The admin compare view displayed package names incorrectly.
The BEO no-tip-jar danger text needed its own class to render correctly across skins.
Setting cc_id on the 187 phase-1 imports lit the dormant v1 Check Cherry badge on those prod clients.
A tightened Finalize BEO UI gate would have hidden the exact prod drink-plan rows the lane was opened for.

The Potions Menu tab displays some ingredients as '[object Object]'.
A Stripe Elements unmount race threw on the client payment form (CLIENT-8, one event).
admin-sw wrote any response as the offline shell, so a direct navigation to /admin-manifest.json cached JSON as the offline boot

Admin service-worker cache entries are never aged out (accepted).
The staff PWA manifest icon purpose was wrong and notificationclick did not focus an existing window.
The staff service worker's notification-click matching uses substring paths, so a tap for /shifts/1 can focus an open /shifts/10 window (the same latent bug already fixed in admin-sw).
Route changes and wizard step changes kept the previous scroll position, landing users mid-page

Admin had no way to download an event's menu print file.
The doc-preview modal's onClose dependency caused a focus bounce.
The command palette hides the desktop Cmd-K hint under pointer:coarse but keeps an Esc chip and ships no visible touch dismiss control.
Admin-only dead affordance at ShiftDrawer.js:667: a label or control styled as tappable with no handler.

The admin header title truncates to 1-2 characters at phone width because the search pill crowds it.
The admin header notification bell rendered with no onClick and a hardcoded 0 count.
Kebab menu's outside-mousedown handler closed the menu on mousedown inside the portal-rendered menu, unmounting items before a normal-speed click landed, so items did not fire
Kebab menu closed synchronously on click, unmounting mailto/tel/sms anchors before the browser's OS hand-off, so those links silently did nothing
New metrics filter bar reused the .seg/.seg-btn class names, colliding with a pre-existing admin-os .seg control and restyling it
ClientConversation's pin-to-bottom effect depended only on [messages] and fired on the loading-placeholder commit, so every clicked message thread opened at the top of its history.
ClientConversation called setState after unmount on three post-await paths
DrinkPlanCard did not refetch after finalize, so the extras-unpaid badge went stale and dropped after an override finalize.
DrinkPlanSelections did not read v2 selection keys, so admin views of v2 plans were incomplete.
Switching an email from simple to design mode has no confirm step.

FileUpload showed a 'Take Photo' button on desktop, where it only opens a file picker

Inbox WHO badges beyond D, Z and AI are not styled.
InvoiceDropdown re-fetched invoices the payment panel already held and was remounted by key on every create/send/void, so it snapped shut each time

Review rounds on the ma-e3 phone money edit sheet were driven by tap-stability hazards: controls that moved under a second tap.
As planned, a single scrolling readout kept its top, so at 320x568 a notice leaving pulled the next one up and moved Reload into Retry place; a second Retry tap would discard the edits.
The note sheet holds no taps as it closes, so the second tap of a double tap lands on the event detail or tab bar and can navigate away.
A start time stored in an unparseable shape shows blank in the edit sheet and is sent back as stored unless changed (accepted).
The phone edit sheet refused a save after any write to the row, including a client merely opening the proposal page (view_count bump stamps updated_at), reading it as changed since you opened it.
RecipeEditor called onDrinkChange without the drink type, so the parent could not tell which drink table changed (bound-type fix added by another session).
matchCancelTargets' greedy shortest-prefix match bound the cancel control to the wrong, cheaper add-on.
